bluetooth: move property_handler_callback on ExportedObjectManagerWrapper Class ExportedObjectManagerWrapper has property_handler_setup_callback_ private property that can only be set through method SetPropertyHandlerSetupCallback(). The property is only used when the method AddExportedInterface() is called. This patch remove the property_handler_setup_callback_ property, and add a property_handler_setup_callback parameter to AddExportedInterface() instead. This is needed to allow ExportedObjectManagerWrapper to be shared by many components so that those components can freely define the property handler callbacks per object/interface. cryptohome: Stop binding TPM 1.2 delegate to PCR0 There are some Chromebook models with buggy firmware that sometimes changes the PCR0 value to an unexpected value. Therefore disable the binding for now for everyone, until those buggy models reach EOL - otherwise the Chrome OS attestation and smart card login features will be broken when the PCR0 is wrong. This CL is, effectively, a revert of https://crrev.com/c/1065826, which introduced the PCR0 binding. readahead: Handle readahead() calls with length larger than 32 pages The readahead() syscall isn't fully honoring the provided |count| parameter despite the man page saying "...bytes are read up to the next page boundary greater than or equal to (offset+count)". Kernels prior to v4.10 are capping the count to 32 pages (128kb). The following commit, included in versions >= 4.10, changed it to the optimal hardware I/O size which appears to be 128 pages on Eve: https://github.com/torvalds/linux/commit/9491ae4aade6814afcfa67f4eb3e3342c2b39750 Fixing this is necessary for preloading the ARCVM system image file which after the ARCVM boot can have up to 4460 contiguous pages in core. Note that this also improves the average Chrome OS boot time as reported over 5 runs by login-prompt-visible in bootstat_summary's output by 12% on Eve. Before this change: login-prompt-visible = [ 4060, 4320, 4090, 4090, 4230 ] After this change: login-prompt-visible = [ 3420, 3770, 3700, 3690, 3690 ] BUG=b:137810150 TEST=ChromeOS boots 12% faster on Eve TEST=grep Cached /proc/meminfo doesn't grow significantly Change-Id: I41dd114a0864b509466580998d4e0dd9e21db162 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1717075 Tested-by: Philippe Liard <pliard@google.com> Commit-Ready: Philippe Liard <pliard@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Yusuke Sato <yusukes@chromium.org>

tast: Check compatibility between tast command and source code. I received many complaints that "tast run -build" fails by cgoMustBeDisabledToBuildTast. This made it clear that people usually sync their checkouts without upgrading the chroot (and tast command). This CL adds a check that the source code layout matches what "tast run -build" expects by comparing sourceCompatVersion defined in build/compat.go. If one in the current checkout differs from the one built in the tast binary, users are asked to run ./update_chroot.
